description: Defines profiles and utility functions for various embedding models, including their dimensions, score thresholds, and query prefixes.

methods.name: getModelDimension
methods.description: Retrieves the embedding dimension for a given provider and model ID.

methods.name: getModelScoreThreshold
methods.description: Retrieves the score threshold for a given provider and model ID.

methods.name: getModelQueryPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves the query prefix for a given provider and model ID.

methods.name: getDefaultModelId
methods.description: Gets the default specific embedding model ID based on the provider.
